metadata.description: Claude mods by threesil: Claw, an OpenClaw-style personal agent, plus Claude Code mods that extend it.

plugins.name: claw
plugins.description: OpenClaw-style personal agent: memory, tasks, inbox triage, daily briefing, heartbeat. Works in the Claude app, Cowork and Claude Code.

plugins.name: claw-memory
plugins.description: Mod: memory injected automatically, remember/recall/forget tools that refuse secrets, daily journal.

plugins.name: claw-hud
plugins.description: Mod: task band above the prompt and a /hud pane to add and tick off tasks.

plugins.name: claw-guard
plugins.description: Mod: asks before any connector action that sends, deletes, pays or shares; flags prompt injection.

plugins.name: claw-heartbeat
plugins.description: Mod: daily briefing and scheduled check-ins inside a running session, with quiet hours.

plugins.name: claw-telegram
plugins.description: Mod: chat with Claw from Telegram, get briefings pushed, approve guarded actions with /approve.

plugins.name: claw-suite
plugins.description: Installs Claw and all Claw mods at once.
